title: Xanthe and the Asset
author: Kestrel Almeida
blurb: Edmund Ashgrove, a burnt analyst bounced from three agencies, works cases no one wants attributed. Then a voiceprint unlocks a server on another continent — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must get the truth past three governments and one assassin, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
